name: score-100-search
target: Mean score and fraction >=100 in Vickrey; win rate retained as safety outcome
methodology: Current exact+denial production composition. 36 fixed training scenarios cross every seat and three strong licensed clone/mutant rosters twice. Each candidate replaces only the same focal seat in a matched control scenario. Pick highest mean score before 72 untouched holdout pairs. No live data/credentials/future tiles.
